title: registry-v0 entry (v1)
description: One participating repository, one file: registry/{owner}--{name}.yml. Implements FS-02 §7 (FS02-060) with the FS-02 §2 field set and the FS-02 §3 state enum verbatim. Phase-D only: this schema is frozen and archived at P-M3, when `pg` + jobs.index-build take over the identical artifact schemas (FS02-064). Draft-07 on purpose — it is the dialect every OSPO scanner and CI linter already speaks.

schema.description: Schema tag. A file whose tag this validator does not know is REJECTED, never ignored: unlike PURPOSE.yml (which is optional overrides and degrades to defaults, D23), a registry entry is the published cache of an adoption and must never half-publish (FS02-063).

example.description: Marks a seeded demonstration entry. `true` entries exist so the tooling has data to run against; index-build-lite EXCLUDES them from every published artifact and CI fails if one leaks into dist/. Real entries omit the key entirely.

node_id.description: GitHub GraphQL repository node_id — the primary key everywhere (FS-00 §6.1, GH-003). owner/name are display cache only and appear in no key. Two forms exist: the current `R_`-prefixed form and the legacy base64 form, whose decoded value begins `010:Repository` (scripts/validate-registry.mjs decodes and checks that; a JSON Schema pattern cannot).

owner.description: GitHub owner login. DISPLAY CACHE ONLY (GH-004) — refreshed by the operator on rename; never a foreign key, never money-bearing (FS02-017). The pattern is GitHub's own login grammar: alphanumerics and single interior hyphens, max 39 characters.

name.description: GitHub repository name. DISPLAY CACHE ONLY. Leading dots and the reserved names `.`/`..` are excluded because they would produce an unusable filename.

default_branch.description: Default branch at the time of curation (FS02-010). Used only to build human links; a stale value never affects registration.

state.description: FS-02 §3 state enum, VERBATIM. `detected` repos appear in aggregate counts only — no listing, no repo record, no badge (GH-014, OPEN-33 default (a)). `powers_suspended` and `allocation_frozen` are the two orthogonal private flags of FS02-020 and are deliberately ABSENT from this schema: they are platform state, never registry data.

state_note.description: Optional short public reason class shown on a tombstone page for `delisted`/`quit` (WEB-075). A reason CLASS, not a narrative, and never a person's name.

license.description: The adopted Purpose Source License version and the evidence for it. The repository's own LICENSE file is the source of truth for adoption (GH-002, LEG-027 as amended, D13); these fields are the cache of what the operator verified.

id.description: SPDX-style identifier of the adopted licence version. The canonical token string is URS OPEN-20; `PurposeSource-1.0` is the working form used by FS02-030.

version.description: Licence version carried by the repo (GH-022). Must agree with `id`; validate-registry.mjs cross-checks.

published.description: Publication date of THIS licence version — the per-version Apache-2.0 conversion clock anchor (D9, FS02-010 license_pub_date). The conversion date published on the repo record is derived from it, never stored.

adopted.description: Date the repository's LICENSE commit landed (FS02-010 adoption_date). Cannot precede `published`.

text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the repository's LICENSE file content, as verified by the operator against the published canonical text (GH-015). A mismatch is not an adoption (D10 verbatim-text rule).

weight_class.description: D11 weight class. Lowercase is the frozen form (FS02-010 CHECK constraint); VS-03's `{Standard, Major}` is display capitalisation. The multiplier itself is Schedule-owned and never appears in this repo (FS02-070: admins pick a class, they never enter numbers). `standard -> major` requires steward approval (FS02-071) — merging a `major` entry IS that approval being recorded, so a reviewer must see the approval reference.

weight_class_approval_ref.description: Required when weight_class is `major`: the public reference (PR or issue URL) recording the steward approval, so the merge is auditable. Enforced by validate-registry.mjs, which can express the conditional cleanly; the schema keeps the field's shape.

inbound_family.description: Inbound licence family of the code the project takes in (FS02-010 inbound_family). Drives the FS-09/WEB-034 adoption gate: `permissive` -> notice-preservation instructions; `copyleft` -> declined, manual consent path; `unknown` -> declined to manual review; `none` -> no inbound third-party code.

impact_category_defaults.description: Optional project-level default routing for the project's charity flow: slugs from the curated category-fund menu ONLY (D16, ENG-033 — free text is structurally impossible). Absent means the steward default applies (FS02-050 tier 3). The enum below MUST equal the slug set in config/category-funds.json; validate-registry.mjs asserts that equality so the two cannot drift.

contacts.description: Curation contacts. LOGINS AND URLs ONLY — no email addresses, no personal names, no phone numbers. This whole repository is data class P0-public (FS-00 §6.9) and PII beyond a GitHub login plus node_id is out of bounds (D15); the field patterns make an email address structurally unrepresentable, and scripts/validate-registry.mjs additionally scans every string in every entry for `@`-shaped text.

admin_logins.description: GitHub logins of the repository administrators the operator corresponded with during curation. Display cache like owner/name: at P-M3 the claim flow (FS-09) becomes the authority and these are informational.

public_contact_url.description: Optional public contact page or discussion URL for the project.

curation.description: Provenance of this entry: how it reached the registry and when. Discovery is a safety net, never the primary channel (FS-02 §4, R8) — `self-registration` is the expected value.

recorded_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the operator recorded this entry (FS-00 §6.1: UTC ISO-8601 everywhere).

review_ref.description: Optional public reference (PR or issue URL) for the curation decision.

allOf.$comment: WAIVERS CAN NEVER ENTER THE REGISTRY (FS02-060, D14). Waiver issuance is dashboard-only, by a claimed admin, from P-M3; at v0 the /waivers/* artifacts render the honest empty state. `additionalProperties: false` already rejects these keys, but a bare 'additional property not allowed' error teaches a contributor nothing, so the ban is also spelled out and validate-registry.mjs turns a hit into a named, quotable failure.

Nor may an entry carry money, entitlements, contributor shares, or manifest parse results. Those are platform state (FS-05/FS-06/FS-07) or P-M3 surfaces; a PR-curated public YAML file is not where any of them may appear.
